view_frame: Front view (XZ) displays the wheel face with X as width and Z as height. Right view (YZ) displays the wheel thickness with Y as depth and Z as height. The wheel is centered at the origin (0,0,0).

features.shape: Revolved solid (Torus-like rim with central hub and radial spokes)
features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4. Outer radius 60mm. Inner radius 50mm (rim). Hub radius 15mm. Spokes connect hub to rim.
features.evidence: Front view shows concentric circles and 8 radial lines. Right view shows a single rectangle. Text labels 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm; 8 spokes'.

connections: Rim, hub, and spokes are a single continuous solid.
Spokes are tangent to the hub and rim inner surfaces.
edit_rules: Changing OD updates the outer radius of the rim.
Changing thickness updates the Y-dimension of the entire body.
Changing spoke count updates the angular spacing of the spokes.
Changing rim_width updates the inner radius of the rim (OD - 2*rim_width).
Changing hub_diameter updates the inner radius of the hub.
unresolved: Rim width (radial thickness of the outer ring) is not dimensioned.
